notes.title: Playtest DOUBT CAMP
notes.notes:
[b]We'd like to invite the participants of the prototype title "VIVA NOBOTS" user test from across all the regions to join us for a round of playful trickery on the last night!
[/b]

[b][Event Schedule][/b] (Recommended Play Times)
[list]
[*] JP Server: May 7th, 18:00-22:00 (JST)
[*] AU Server: May 7th, 18:00-22:00 (AEDT)
[*] EU Server: May 7th, 18:00-22:00 (UTC)
[*] SA Server: May 6th, 18:00-22:00 (BRT)
[*] US Server: May 6th, 18:00-22:00 (PST)
[/list]
[i]Feel free to switch server regions if you'd like to participate.
Of course, you are welcome to play outside of the listed times too.[/i]

[b][Recommended Stage][/b]
If you're level 10 or higher, try playing on the "Amber Ruins: Adept"

[b][Presents][/b]
On May 6th 0:00 UTC, we'll be distributing the following to your present box:
[list]
[*]  • 10,000x Medals
[*]  • 30x Power Fruits of each variety 🍌🍊🍇🍐🍋 
[/list]
You can locate the present box on the top menu in-game. Use these to unlock skills, change your style, and more!

If you have any questions about this event, please contact us on Discord.

▼VIVA NOBOTS Discord Channel
[url=https://discord.gg/fZCKKwBH6q]https://discord.gg/fZCKKwBH6q[/url]

notes.title: On Matchmaking and Network Settings
notes.notes:
During this Playtest period, there will be no matchmaking restrictions based on player levels. As a result, new players may be matched with experienced, and even top-ranked players.

Additionally, we've noticed that player count tends to be highest between 6:00 PM and 11:00 PM local time zone, so if you're having difficulty finding a match, please try logging in at those times.

▼ Available Servers
JP: Japan / EU: Europe / US: North America / SA: South America / AU: Australia

notes.title: Issue Detected: Player Data Issue in Amber Ruins
notes.notes:
Notice of Issue
We have identified the following issue currently affecting gameplay.
This issue is scheduled to be resolved in a future update.
We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and ask for your patience until the fix is implemented.

Details of the Issue:
When multiple players enter the same ruins simultaneously, there is a low probability that player data may not be properly reflected, and the game may start with another player's data instead.

Affected Scope:
All players who entered the same ruins simultaneously.

Affected Locations:
Amber Ruins - Beginner, Intermediate, and Advanced levels.

We have confirmed that player data will return to normal upon exiting the ruins and that no data corruption occurs.
While we are working to resolve this issue, if you encounter this problem, we kindly ask you to exit the ruins.
Note: After exiting the ruins normally, a blank dialog box will appear, followed by a transition to the title screen.

We deeply apologize for any inconvenience caused.
Thank you for your continued support of VIVA NOBOTS.

notes.title: Notice: Issue Resolved
notes.notes:
We would like to inform you that the issue preventing access to ruins on the JP server, caused by a network disruption around April 25, 21:00 (JST), has now been resolved.
We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience this may have caused our players.
Thank you for your continued support and understanding.

▼ Discord, click here:
https://discord.gg/fZCKKwBH6q
